title: Fun in the Park
text:
We go to the park in spring. The park has a big slide and swings. I play on the swings with my friend Tom. The flowers are red and yellow.

In winter the park is cold. There is snow on the ground. We make a snowman. Then we go home and drink hot chocolate.

questions.text: What does the writer play on in the park?
What is on the ground in winter?
How does the writer probably feel when they go to the park?
Why do the children drink hot chocolate after they make the snowman?

vocabulary.definition: a large public area with grass, trees and places to play
seats hung from ropes that children sit on and move back and forth
white, cold pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky
the coldest season of the year

paragraph_translations: Vamos al parque en primavera. El parque tiene un tobogán grande y columpios. Juego en los columpios con mi amigo Tom. Las flores son rojas y amarillas.
En invierno el parque está frío. Hay nieve en el suelo. Hacemos un muñeco de nieve. Luego vamos a casa y tomamos chocolate caliente.
